description: Calculate daily almagate grams for a standard dose of a supported Almax presentation and check the leaflet's age, 8 g/day and 14-day limits. daily_doses_intended means administrations per day, not tablets or sachets. This checks label limits only; it cannot establish individual clinical safety. treatment_days is needed to check duration.

daily_doses_intended.description: Number of standard administrations per day; the standard dose size is determined by product_variant.

product_variant.description: Almax presentation. forte_comprimidos uses the 750 mg tablet leaflet; one standard dose is two tablets.

treatment_days.description: Planned number of days. Omit only if unknown; then the 14-day limit cannot be assessed.

name: get_almax_dosage_calculator
title: Check Almax Label Dosage Limits
